description: This file implements a Go client for interacting with a documentation AI process via RPC. It manages starting the process, handling communication, sending prompts, and parsing responses, specifically designed for an internal documentation or language model interface.

classes.name: docsPiClient
classes.description: A client structure managing the lifecycle of the external process, communication channels, and synchronization primitives for interacting with the documentation AI process.

methods.name: startDocsPiClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the external documentation AI process, returning a client for interaction.

methods.name: Prompt
methods.description: Sends a prompt message to the external process and waits for a response or error.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the client and the associated process.

methods.name: captureStderr
methods.description: Captures standard error output from the external process into an internal buffer.

methods.name: readStdout
methods.description: Reads from the process's stdout, parsing JSON messages and forwarding events.
